name: The Night of the Exorcism
source:
Summoned to the remote village of Southshire-Upon-Yail, you must diagnose the afflictions of a young woman that suffers a mysterious illness. Each decision you make will unveil a piece of the mystery and bring you closer to discovering the truth behind her ailments, and whatever harms her.

However, the devils inside Isabella will not be removed easily. Navigate the seven creatures that hold her life in her hands, and find a way to expel them one by one – or succumb to their temptations.

The secrets of Hell can be discovered, at a cost, and only through information if your exorcism succeed. But can you trick the demons into exposing their cores, or will you leave yourself open to them? Will you understand the diabolical machine, or fall victim to the devils’ manipulations?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3424010/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你被召唤到偏远的南郡亚伊尔村庄，必须诊断一名患有神秘疾病的年轻女子的痛苦。你做出的每一个决定都会揭开一个谜团，让你更接近发现她的疾病和伤害她的一切背后的真相。

然而，伊莎贝拉内心的恶魔不会轻易除掉。驾驭掌握着她生命的七个生物，并找到一种方法将它们一一驱逐——或者屈服于它们的诱惑。

如果你的驱魔成功，地狱的秘密就可以被发现，但需要付出一定的代价，而且只有通过信息才能发现。但你能诱骗恶魔暴露他们的核心，还是让自己暴露在他们面前？你会理解这台邪恶的机器，还是成为魔鬼操纵的受害者？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3424010/]Steam[/url]]
